taskDescription: Add `destroy-factories` command: kill all other Claude terminals and start one fresh factory. Changes needed: Add a new command (likely `commands/destroy-factories.md`) that: Detects and terminates all other running Claude / dark-factory terminals/sessions; Spawns a fresh factory in a new terminal; Leaves the user with exactly one active terminal (the new one). Confirm cross-platform behavior (or document the supported platform) for finding + killing the other Claude processes. Make the command safe enough that it won't take down unrelated terminals — only ones running Claude.
